semantics.priority: Prefer currently eligible work across the complete same-generation scan. Each page scans at most two candidates; the completed scan may recheck one earlier held candidate. Incomplete pages continue scanning.
semantics.authority: Both claim forms retain approval_required:true and send_authorized:false. Fresh model approval and final publication eligibility remain mandatory.
semantics.recoverable_holds: Only fixed server-allowlisted operational reasons on unexpired unfrozen mutable items. Model pauses, owner pauses and every committed intent are excluded.
semantics.wake: No automatic next_wake_at while an indefinite operational hold remains. Restoration permits ordinary readiness/claim re-evaluation without changing the intent key.
semantics.cancellation: A valid review-only claim can cancel its exact revision while operational publication remains held.
semantics.other_response_changes: No removed or renamed original fields. Claim null responses have no added claim object. Approve/publish/cancel shapes unchanged.
